findings.title: Production host is pinned at the Lightsail small_3_0 CPU baseline: burst credits at 0% since 2026-09-02
Package pages answer 503 almost always: CSX_DB_READ_CONNS=2 and CSX_DB_READ_WAIT=250ms override on the host plus multi-query page fan-out
Aggregation builder runs back-to-back (5-minute interval, ~40-minute passes) and rewrites every cluster and snapshot of touched packages: 20.0M failure_clusters upserts wrote 84,580 rows in 6 days
ListFailureClusters per package is the single largest statement by total time: 337k calls, 283 ms mean, 82,486 s of disk read
Authoring candidate scan (whole-corpus MATERIALIZED CTE) ran 3,375 times in 6 days at 10-183 s each and times out on the 8 s ceiling
/dependencies aggregates the whole dependency_edge table per page view (109,701 rows sorted and grouped, 10.2 s CPU, cache-warm) and exceeds the 8 s statement timeout
Every deploy or restart serves 502 to all visitors and shard clients while the server reconciles before listening: 1,255 today, 431 on 09-14, 2,529 on 09-13
Shard API returns 429 to clients at a steady rate (749 today, 1,354 on 09-14) while the same route also carries the 502 storms
217 live samples whose most recent verification did not pass are still served as CROSS_PASS or PUBLISHED; 77 of those receipts carry no stageFailures
Exact duplicates re-accumulated after the 2026-08-19 dedup: 205 live purl+symbol groups (214 redundant samples), 518 identical-contract groups (677 redundant), 44 duplicate case ids

Package coordinate spelling is inconsistent across the corpus: 68 live manifests use raw @ scoped npm purls while 1,617 use %40; 76 golang purls omit the v prefix; 130 samples never match their receipt resolvedPackages purely because of spelling
1,679 live samples (24%) have no PASS receipt that names a verifier image digest; 657 receipts are schema v1 and 4,058 v2 receipts carry resolvedPackages but no verifierImage
CROSS_PASS rests on one verifier key for 5,713 of 6,621 samples; the whole corpus was verified by 5 keys, 3 of them operator-run farm/mill nodes
3,506 live samples (50%) still carry the template goal verify X in pkg:..., 1,809 (26%) have no subject, 1,228 (17%) declare no symbols, 49 disagree between manifest.symbols and case.symbols
388 of 2,118 sampled package versions (18%) are a whole major behind the newest version the network has observed in the wild

Demand is already saturated at package and version level (1,180 of 1,192 wanted packages and 4,578 of 4,627 wanted versions have a sample); 76% of live samples have never been shown in a search hit; density is concentrated in 61 packages holding 35% of samples
No request latency is recorded anywhere: the safe access log drops duration, page views are skipped, and docker logs are lost on every container recreate
Hot tables are heavily rewritten: failure_clusters 15.2M updates on 236k rows (1,397 B/row), compatibility_snapshots 11.1M updates on 21.7k rows; DB temp files total 4.6 TB lifetime
/admin/api/farm answers 503 (background-class query timeout) under current load, and the anonymous analytics writer logs write-unavailable 40 times per hour

exhaustive: every live and quarantined sample row

EXPLAIN ANALYZE: one representative package (lru-cache) per query family
host telemetry: one 5-second vmstat/top window plus /proc/stat and PSI cumulative counters

FAIL-row evidence_quality split on evidence_agg (query exceeded 240 s)
per-request server render vs DB split (no latency log exists)
contract accuracy beyond structural checks (needs re-execution; not done to avoid load)
